item.title: Leopold Banchini Architects draws on prehistoric civilisation for Asympta pavilion
item.description: Swiss studio Leopold Banchini Architects has created Asympta, a stone-and-wood pavilion that evokes the "unknown domestic architectures" of prehistoric societies in today's Sicily.
